caption: The drawing consists of a detailed grayscale illustration of a wall-mounted candle holder with a candle, accompanied by two smaller elevation drawings and a scale below the leftmost rendering. The main object is a vertically mounted metal sconce with a semicircular trough at the base, which holds a long, irregularly shaped candle. The backplate of the sconce is rectangular with a rounded top forming a fan or shell-like pattern, adorned with radiating grooves, and features an elliptical hole near the upper center. The sconce surface shows small, evenly spaced dots or indentations as decorative or structural elements. The candle is cylindrical, tapering slightly at the top, and appears to have an unlit, darkened wick. The smaller renderings in the upper left and upper right corners show the sconce in front and side profile views, both with the candle in place. All objects are rendered in shades of gray on a beige background, and the entire drawing is enclosed in a rectangular frame. At the lower left corner, the name “Mildred Ford” is written.
title: Candle Sconce
